Question: Let \(S\) be the set of points \((x,y)\) in the coordinate plane such that two of the three quantities \(3,\) \(x+2,\) and \(y-4\) are equal and the third of the three quantities is no greater than this common value. Which of the following is a correct description of \(S?\)

Choices.C:
three lines whose pairwise intersections are three distinct
points
Choices.E: three rays with a common endpoint
